data.heading: What is included in each plan

items.question: Starter · $12 / month
items.answer: One site, 5 pages, free SSL and email support. Ideal for personal projects and portfolios.

items.question: Growth · $39 / month
items.answer: Up to five sites, unlimited pages, form automation, analytics and priority chat support.

items.question: Scale · $99 / month
items.answer: Unlimited sites, team roles, staging environments, audit logs and a dedicated success manager.
